text:
marta: Heads-up — we need to converge on launch constraints for the new "Priority Microtier" before Thurs exec sync. Customer asks + legal carveouts knocking on the door.
samir: high level: customers want guaranteed burst for 99th pct latency and a soft SLA for reserved throughput. Doable without a big infra lift?
kai: short answer: yes if we limit burst window and cap concurrent sessions per tenant. infra cost grows with burst headroom though.
elaine: product ask: keep onboarding friction <2 days. If contracts require per-customer capacity planning we'll lose PLG motion.
chen: proposed compromise:
```
- Tier: Priority Microtier
- Base quota: 2M tokens / mo
- Reserved concurrency: 20 (guaranteed)
- Burst: +50% for 10s per minute, circuit-breaker at 3x avg
- Add-on: dedicated concurrency pools (paid)
```
samir: love specificity. two questions: (1) who enforces circuit-breaker? runtime or routing layer? (2) how do we bill burst vs base?
kai: runtime should enforce CB for speed. billing: prorate burst tokens at 1.5x base rate to discourage constant abuse.
jen (sales): customers will ask for exceptions. Need a clear approval matrix: sales can sign up to +5% burst at term, legal for anything higher.
marta: good. also need launch criteria: 1) perf tests show 99p latency < target on sample workloads, 2) run pilot with 3 customers for 2 weeks, 3) docs + pricing page ready.
elaine: add a guardrail: do not expose dedicated concurrency add-on to self-serve until capacity estimator exists.
chen: rollout plan draft:
- week 0: finalize pricing and approval matrix
- week 1: implement circuit-breaker + billing flags
- week 2: run internal perf benchmarks
- week 3–4: pilot with customers A/B
- week 5: GA
samir: risk: if pilot customers have huge variance we'll need manual overrides. Expect 1–2 emergency capacity adds.
jen (sales): we can tolerate that if we price pilot at a small premium and include playbook for manual scale.
contracts-bot: Reminder: any tier with "guaranteed" language requires SLA clause review. See /policies/sla-drafts.
tom: ops note: need an alert on burst exhaustion and a dashboard tile for per-tenant burst usage.
marta: decision calls we need today: (A) billing multiplier for burst (1.5x?) (B) burst window length (10s?) (C) self-serve exposure for add-on (no).
jen (sales): A=1.5x ok. B=10s feels tight vs customer ask for short spikes but keeps cost predictable. C=hold off on self-serve.
kai: agree with A/B/C. I'll slot infra work behind a medium-priority ticket.
chen: I'll update spec and post PR with flags + CB params. Will add sample k6 workload for perf tests.
marta: awesome — if anyone objects ping me now. If not, we'll ship spec to execs by EOD.
samir: no objections from eng side. :+1:
elaine: no objections from product. adding pilot readiness checklist to docs.
jen (sales): prepping customer communications.
contracts-bot: Logged: SLA review request created (#SLA-3421).
marta: thanks all — follow-ups in the PR thread.
